payload.author: claude
payload.body: Scope correction: rangercrm-server removed from the Frick repo (it is private product code; the live copy lives in the RangerCRM repo). FR-254 cancelled. The epic is now framework-only: remaining work is tooling (CLI FR-252, MCP FR-253), the acceptance gate (conformance FR-250, SDK acceptance FR-251), and the cutover (FR-255).
